segments.an6.54:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
segments.an6.54:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā dhammiko jātibhūmiyaṃ āvāsiko hoti sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattasu āvāsesu.
segments.an6.54:1.3: Tatra sudaṃ āyasmā dhammiko āgantuke bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati vihiṃsati vitudati roseti vācāya.
segments.an6.54:1.4: Te ca āgantukā bhikkhū āyasmatā dhammikena akkosiyamānā paribhāsiyamānā vihesiyamānā vitudiyamānā rosiyamānā vācāya pakkamanti, na saṇṭhanti [na saṇṭhahanti (sī.)], riñcanti āvāsaṃ.
segments.an6.54:2.1: Atha kho jātibhūmakānaṃ [jātibhūmikānaṃ (syā. pī. ka.)] upāsakānaṃ etadahosi –
segments.an6.54:2.3: Atha ca pana āgantukā bhikkhū pakkamanti, na saṇṭhanti, riñcanti āvāsaṃ.
segments.an6.54:2.4: Ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo yena āgantukā bhikkhū pakkamanti, na saṇṭhanti, riñcanti āvāsan”ti?
segments.an6.54:2.6: “ayaṃ kho āyasmā dhammiko āgantuke bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati vihiṃsati vitudati roseti vācāya.
segments.an6.54:2.7: Te ca āgantukā bhikkhū āyasmatā dhammikena akkosiyamānā paribhāsiyamānā vihesiyamānā vitudiyamānā rosiyamānā vācāya pakkamanti, na saṇṭhanti, riñcanti āvāsaṃ.
segments.an6.54:3.1: Atha kho jātibhūmakā upāsakā yena āyasmā dhammiko tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ dhammikaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.an6.54:3.4: Atha kho āyasmā dhammiko tamhā āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ agamāsi.
segments.an6.54:3.5: Tatrapi sudaṃ āyasmā dhammiko āgantuke bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati vihiṃsati vitudati roseti vācāya.
segments.an6.54:3.6: Te ca āgantukā bhikkhū āyasmatā dhammikena akkosiyamānā paribhāsiyamānā vihesiyamānā vitudiyamānā rosiyamānā vācāya pakkamanti, na saṇṭhanti, riñcanti āvāsaṃ.
segments.an6.54:4.3: Atha ca pana āgantukā bhikkhū pakkamanti, na saṇṭhanti, riñcanti āvāsaṃ.

segments.an6.54:5.1: Atha kho jātibhūmakā upāsakā yenāyasmā dhammiko tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ dhammikaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.an6.54:5.4: Atha kho āyasmā dhammiko tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ agamāsi.
segments.an6.54:5.5: Tatrapi sudaṃ āyasmā dhammiko āgantuke bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati vihiṃsati vitudati roseti vācāya.
segments.an6.54:5.6: Te ca āgantukā bhikkhū āyasmatā dhammikena akkosiyamānā paribhāsiyamānā vihesiyamānā vitudiyamānā rosiyamānā vācāya pakkamanti, na saṇṭhanti, riñcanti āvāsaṃ.
segments.an6.54:6.3: Atha ca pana āgantukā bhikkhū pakkamanti, na saṇṭhanti, riñcanti āvāsaṃ.

segments.an6.54:6.5: Atha kho jātibhūmakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ etadahosi – “ayaṃ kho āyasmā dhammiko āgantuke bhikkhū akkosati … pe ….
segments.an6.54:6.6: Yaṃnūna mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ dhammikaṃ pabbājeyyāma sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattahi āvāsehī”ti.
segments.an6.54:6.7: Atha kho jātibhūmakā upāsakā yenāyasmā dhammiko tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ dhammikaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.an6.54:6.8: “pakkamatu, bhante, āyasmā dhammiko sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattahi āvāsehī”ti.
segments.an6.54:6.10: “pabbājito khomhi jātibhūmakehi upāsakehi sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattahi āvāsehi.
segments.an6.54:7.1: Atha kho āyasmā dhammiko pattacīvaramādāya yena rājagahaṃ tena pakkāmi.
segments.an6.54:7.2: Anupubbena yena rājagahaṃ gijjhakūṭo pabbato yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ dhammikaṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.an6.54:7.3: “handa kuto nu tvaṃ, brāhmaṇa dhammika, āgacchasī”ti?
segments.an6.54:7.4: “Pabbājito ahaṃ, bhante, jātibhūmakehi upāsakehi sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattahi āvāsehī”ti.
segments.an6.54:7.5: “Alaṃ, brāhmaṇa dhammika, kiṃ te iminā, yaṃ taṃ tato tato pabbājenti, so tvaṃ tato tato pabbājito mameva santike āgacchasi”.
segments.an6.54:8.1: “Bhūtapubbaṃ, brāhmaṇa dhammika, sāmuddikā vāṇijā tīradassiṃ sakuṇaṃ gahetvā nāvāya samuddaṃ ajjhogāhanti.
segments.an6.54:8.2: Te atīradakkhiṇiyā [atīradassaniyā (syā.), atīradassiyā (ka.)] nāvāya tīradassiṃ sakuṇaṃ muñcanti.
segments.an6.54:8.3: So gacchateva puratthimaṃ disaṃ, gacchati pacchimaṃ disaṃ, gacchati uttaraṃ disaṃ, gacchati dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ, gacchati uddhaṃ, gacchati anudisaṃ.
segments.an6.54:8.4: Sace so samantā tīraṃ passati, tathāgatakova [tathāgato (ka.) dī. ni.1.497 passitabbaṃ] hoti.
segments.an6.54:8.5: Sace pana so samantā tīraṃ na passati tameva nāvaṃ paccāgacchati.
segments.an6.54:8.6: Evamevaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa dhammika, yaṃ taṃ tato tato pabbājenti so tvaṃ tato tato pabbājito mameva santike āgacchasi.
segments.an6.54:9.1: “Bhūtapubbaṃ, brāhmaṇa dhammika, rañño korabyassa suppatiṭṭho nāma nigrodharājā ahosi pañcasākho sītacchāyo manoramo.
segments.an6.54:9.2: Suppatiṭṭhassa kho pana, brāhmaṇa dhammika, nigrodharājassa dvādasayojanāni abhiniveso ahosi, pañca yojanāni mūlasantānakānaṃ.
segments.an6.54:9.3: Suppatiṭṭhassa kho pana, brāhmaṇa dhammika, nigrodharājassa tāva mahantāni phalāni ahesuṃ;
segments.an6.54:9.7: Suppatiṭṭhassa kho pana, brāhmaṇa dhammika, nigrodharājassa ekaṃ khandhaṃ rājā paribhuñjati saddhiṃ itthāgārena, ekaṃ khandhaṃ balakāyo paribhuñjati, ekaṃ khandhaṃ negamajānapadā paribhuñjanti, ekaṃ khandhaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇā paribhuñjanti, ekaṃ khandhaṃ migā [migapakkhino (sī. syā. pī.)] paribhuñjanti.
segments.an6.54:9.8: Suppatiṭṭhassa kho pana, brāhmaṇa dhammika, nigrodharājassa na koci phalāni rakkhati, na ca sudaṃ [na ca puna (ka.)] aññamaññassa phalāni hiṃsanti.
segments.an6.54:10.1: “Atha kho, brāhmaṇa dhammika, aññataro puriso suppatiṭṭhassa nigrodharājassa yāvadatthaṃ phalāni bhakkhitvā sākhaṃ bhañjitvā pakkāmi.
segments.an6.54:10.2: Atha kho, brāhmaṇa dhammika, suppatiṭṭhe nigrodharāje adhivatthāya devatāya etadahosi –
segments.an6.54:10.4: Yāva pāpo manusso [yāva pāpamanusso (syā.), yāvatā pāpamanusso (ka.)], yatra hi nāma suppatiṭṭhassa nigrodharājassa yāvadatthaṃ phalāni bhakkhitvā sākhaṃ bhañjitvā pakkamissati, yaṃnūna suppatiṭṭho nigrodharājā āyatiṃ phalaṃ na dadeyyā’ti.
segments.an6.54:10.5: Atha kho, brāhmaṇa dhammika, suppatiṭṭho nigrodharājā āyatiṃ phalaṃ na adāsi.
segments.an6.54:11.1: “Atha kho, brāhmaṇa dhammika, rājā korabyo yena sakko devānamindo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an6.54:11.2: ‘yagghe, mārisa, jāneyyāsi suppatiṭṭho nigrodharājā phalaṃ na detī’ti?
segments.an6.54:11.3: Atha kho, brāhmaṇa dhammika, sakko devānamindo tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi [abhisaṅkhāresi (syā. ka.)], yathā bhusā vātavuṭṭhi āgantvā suppatiṭṭhaṃ nigrodharājaṃ pavattesi [pātesi (sī. pī.)] ummūlamakāsi.
segments.an6.54:11.4: Atha kho, brāhmaṇa dhammika, suppatiṭṭhe nigrodharāje adhivatthā devatā dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
segments.an6.54:12.1: “Atha kho, brāhmaṇa dhammika, sakko devānamindo yena suppatiṭṭhe nigrodharāje adhivatthā devatā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā suppatiṭṭhe nigrodharāje adhivatthaṃ devataṃ etadavoca –
segments.an6.54:12.2: ‘kiṃ nu tvaṃ, devate, dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā ekamantaṃ ṭhitā’ti?
segments.an6.54:12.3: ‘Tathā hi pana me, mārisa, bhusā vātavuṭṭhi āgantvā bhavanaṃ pavattesi ummūlamakāsī’ti.
segments.an6.54:12.4: ‘Api nu tvaṃ, devate, rukkhadhamme ṭhitāya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi āgantvā bhavanaṃ pavattesi ummūlamakāsī’ti?
segments.an6.54:12.5: ‘Kathaṃ pana, mārisa, rukkho rukkhadhamme ṭhito hotī’ti?
segments.an6.54:12.6: ‘Idha, devate, rukkhassa mūlaṃ mūlatthikā haranti, tacaṃ tacatthikā haranti, pattaṃ pattatthikā haranti, pupphaṃ pupphatthikā haranti, phalaṃ phalatthikā haranti.
segments.an6.54:12.7: Na ca tena devatāya anattamanatā vā anabhinandi [anabhiraddhi (sī.)] vā karaṇīyā.
segments.an6.54:12.8: Evaṃ kho, devate, rukkho rukkhadhamme ṭhito hotī’ti.
segments.an6.54:12.9: ‘Aṭṭhitāyeva kho me, mārisa, rukkhadhamme bhusā vātavuṭṭhi āgantvā bhavanaṃ pavattesi ummūlamakāsī’ti.
segments.an6.54:12.10: ‘Sace kho tvaṃ, devate, rukkhadhamme tiṭṭheyyāsi, siyā [siyāpi (sī. pī.)] te bhavanaṃ yathāpure’ti?
segments.an6.54:12.11: ‘Ṭhassāmahaṃ,[tiṭṭheyyāmahaṃ (syā.)] mārisa, rukkhadhamme, hotu me bhavanaṃ yathāpure’”ti.
segments.an6.54:13.1: “Atha kho, brāhmaṇa dhammika, sakko devānamindo tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi [abhisaṅkhāri (syā. ka.)], yathā bhusā vātavuṭṭhi āgantvā suppatiṭṭhaṃ nigrodharājaṃ ussāpesi, sacchavīni mūlāni ahesuṃ.
segments.an6.54:13.2: Evamevaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa dhammika, api nu taṃ samaṇadhamme ṭhitaṃ jātibhūmakā upāsakā pabbājesuṃ sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattahi āvāsehī”ti?
segments.an6.54:13.3: “Kathaṃ pana, bhante, samaṇo samaṇadhamme ṭhito hotī”ti?
segments.an6.54:13.4: “Idha, brāhmaṇa dhammika, samaṇo akkosantaṃ na paccakkosati, rosantaṃ na paṭirosati, bhaṇḍantaṃ na paṭibhaṇḍati.
segments.an6.54:13.5: Evaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa dhammika, samaṇo samaṇadhamme ṭhito hotī”ti.
segments.an6.54:13.6: “Aṭṭhitaṃyeva maṃ, bhante, samaṇadhamme jātibhūmakā upāsakā pabbājesuṃ sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattahi āvāsehī”ti.
segments.an6.54:13.7: [a. ni.7.66;7.73]“Bhūtapubbaṃ, brāhmaṇa dhammika, sunetto nāma satthā ahosi titthakaro kāmesu vītarāgo.
segments.an6.54:13.8: Sunettassa kho pana, brāhmaṇa dhammika, satthuno anekāni sāvakasatāni ahesuṃ.
segments.an6.54:13.9: Sunetto satthā sāvakānaṃ brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṃ desesi.
segments.an6.54:13.10: Ye kho pana, brāhmaṇa dhammika, sunettassa satthuno brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṃ desentassa cittāni na pasādesuṃ te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjiṃsu.
segments.an6.54:13.11: Ye kho pana, brāhmaṇa dhammika, sunettassa satthuno brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṃ desentassa cittāni pasādesuṃ te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjiṃsu.
segments.an6.54:14.1: “Bhūtapubbaṃ, brāhmaṇa dhammika, mūgapakkho nāma satthā ahosi … pe … aranemi nāma satthā ahosi … kuddālako nāma satthā ahosi … hatthipālo nāma satthā ahosi … jotipālo nāma satthā ahosi titthakaro kāmesu vītarāgo.
segments.an6.54:18.2: Jotipālassa kho pana, brāhmaṇa dhammika, satthuno anekāni sāvakasatāni ahesuṃ.
segments.an6.54:18.3: Jotipālo satthā sāvakānaṃ brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṃ desesi.
segments.an6.54:18.4: Ye kho pana, brāhmaṇa dhammika, jotipālassa satthuno brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṃ desentassa cittāni na pasādesuṃ te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjiṃsu.
segments.an6.54:18.5: Ye kho pana, brāhmaṇa dhammika, jotipālassa satthuno brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṃ desentassa cittāni pasādesuṃ te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjiṃsu.
segments.an6.54:19.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, brāhmaṇa dhammika, yo ime cha satthāre titthakare kāmesu vītarāge, anekasataparivāre sasāvakasaṅghe paduṭṭhacitto akkoseyya paribhāseyya, bahuṃ so apuññaṃ pasaveyyā”ti?
segments.an6.54:19.4: “Yo kho, brāhmaṇa dhammika, ime cha satthāre titthakare kāmesu vītarāge anekasataparivāre sasāvakasaṅghe paduṭṭhacitto akkoseyya paribhāseyya, bahuṃ so apuññaṃ pasaveyya.
segments.an6.54:19.5: Yo ekaṃ diṭṭhisampannaṃ puggalaṃ paduṭṭhacitto akkosati paribhāsati, ayaṃ tato bahutaraṃ apuññaṃ pasavati.
segments.an6.54:19.7: Nāhaṃ, brāhmaṇa dhammika, ito bahiddhā evarūpiṃ khantiṃ [evarūpaṃ khantaṃ (syā.)] vadāmi, yathāmaṃ sabrahmacārīsu.
segments.an6.54:19.9: ‘na no samasabrahmacārīsu [na no āmasabrahmacārīsu (syā.), na no sabrahmacārīsu (sī. pī.)] cittāni paduṭṭhāni bhavissantī’”ti.
segments.an6.54:20.3: Kuddālako ahu satthā, hatthipālo ca māṇavo.
segments.an6.54:22.3: Kāmarāgaṃ virājetvā, brahmalokūpagā ahuṃ [ahu (bahūsu), ahū (ka. sī.)].
segments.an6.54:23.5: Kāmarāgaṃ virājetvā, brahmalokūpagā ahuṃ [ahu (bahūsu), ahū (ka. sī.)].
segments.an6.54:24.5: Bahuñca so pasavati, apuññaṃ tādiso naro.
segments.an6.54:25.5: Ayaṃ tato bahutaraṃ, apuññaṃ pasave naro.
segments.an6.54:27.3: Saddhā sati ca vīriyaṃ, samatho ca vipassanā.
segments.an6.54:29.1: “Yo ca rakkhati attānaṃ, rakkhito tassa bāhiro;
segments.an6.54:29.3: Tasmā rakkheyya attānaṃ, akkhato paṇḍito sadā”ti.
segments.an6.54:30.1: Nāgamigasālā iṇaṃ, cundaṃ dve sandiṭṭhikā duve;

lines: Kiṃ te imināti kiṃ tava iminā jātibhūmiyaṃ vāsena.
Na ca sudaṃ aññamaññassa phalāni hiṃsantīti aññamaññassa koṭṭhāse phalāni na hiṃsanti.
Attano koṭṭhāsehi mūlaṃ vā tacaṃ vā pattaṃ vā chindanto nāma natthi, attano attano sākhāya heṭṭhā patitāneva paribhuñjanti.
Aññassa koṭṭhāsato aññasa koṭṭhāsaṃ parivattitvā gatampi “na amhākaṃ sākhāya phalan”ti ñatvā no khādanti.
Sākhaṃ bhañjitvāti chattappamāṇamattaṃ chinditvā chāyaṃ katvā pakkāmi.

Tenupasaṅkamīti janapadavāsīhi gantvā,“mahārāja, rukkho phalaṃ na gaṇhi, amhākaṃ nu kho doso tumhākan”ti vutte “neva mayhaṃ doso atthi, na jānapadānaṃ, amhākaṃ vijite adhammo nāma na vattati, kena nu kho kāraṇena rukkho na phalito, sakkaṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchissāmī”ti cintetvā yena sakko devānamindo tenupasaṅkami.
Sunettoti nettā vuccanti akkhīni, tesaṃ sundaratāya sunetto.
Yathāmaṃ sabrahmacārīsūti yathā imaṃ sabrahmacārīsu akkosanaparibhāsanaṃ, aññaṃ evarūpaṃ guṇakhantiṃ na vadāmīti attho.
Na no samasabrahmacārīsūti ettha samajano nāma sakajano vuccati.
Tasmā na no sakesu samānabrahmacārīsu cittāni paduṭṭhāni bhavissantīti ayamettha attho.
Jotipālo ca govindoti nāmena jotipālo ṭhānena mahāgovindo.
Ahiṃsakā atītaṃseti ete cha satthāro atītaṃse ahiṃsakā ahesuṃ.
Karuṇevimuttāti karuṇajjhāne adhimuttā, karuṇāya ca karuṇāpubbabhāge ca ṭhitā.
Tassa hi tāni sakadāgāmiṃ upādāya mudūni nāma honti.

lines: Dvādasame jātibhūmiyanti ettha jananaṃ jāti, jātiyā bhūmi jātibhūmi, jātaṭṭhānaṃ.
Taṃ kho panetaṃ neva kosalamahārājādīnaṃ, na caṅkibrāhmaṇādīnaṃ, na sakkasuyāmasantusitādīnaṃ, na asītimahāsāvakānaṃ, na aññesaṃ sattānaṃ “jātibhūmī”ti vuccati.

Yassa pana jātadivase dasasahassī lokadhātu ekaddhajamālāvippakiṇṇakusumavāsacuṇṇagaṇasugandhā sabbapāliphullamiva nandanavanaṃ virocamānā paduminipaṇṇe udakabindu viya akampittha, jaccandhādīnañca rūpadassanādīni anekāni pāṭihāriyāni pavattiṃsu.
Tassa sabbaññubodhisattassa jātaṭṭhānaṃ, sātisayassa pana janakakapilavatthusannissayo “jātibhūmī”ti vuccati.
Tāni pana atthato mūlāniyevāti āha “mūlasantānakānanti mūlānan”ti.
Jātadivase āvudhānaṃ jotitattā, rañño aparimitassa ca sattakāyassa anatthato paripālanasamatthatāya ca “jotipālo”ti laddhanāmattā vuttaṃ “nāmena jotipālo”ti.
Govindoti govindiyābhisekena abhisitto, govindassa ṭhāne ṭhapanābhisekena abhisittoti attho.
Taṃ kira tassa brāhmaṇassa kulaparamparāgataṃ ṭhānantaraṃ.
Gavaṃ paññañca vindati paṭilabhatīti govindo, mahanto govindoti mahāgovindo.
Goti hi paññāyetaṃ adhivacanaṃ “gacchati atthe bujjhatī”ti katvā.

So kira disampatissa nāma rañño purohitassa govindabrāhmaṇassa putto hutvā attano pitussa ca rañño ca accayena tassa putto reṇu, sahāyā cassa sattabhū, brahmadatto, vessabhū, bharato, dve dhataraṭṭhāti ime satta rājāno yathā aññamaññaṃ na vivadanti.

Evaṃ rajje patiṭṭhāpetvā tesaṃ atthadhamme anusāsante jambudīpatale sabbesaṃ rājāva raññaṃ, brahmāva brāhmaṇānaṃ, devova gahapatikānaṃ sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito uttamagāravaṭṭhānaṃ ahosi.
Reṇu dve ca dhataraṭṭhā, tadāsuṃ satta bhāradhā”ti.(dī. ni. aṭṭha.2.308);
Rañño diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikatthānaṃ puro vidhānato pure saṃvidhānato purohito.
Karuṇā assa atthīti karuṇanti sapubbabhāgakaruṇajjhānaṃ vuttanti āha “karuṇāya ca karuṇāpubbabhāge ca ṭhitā”ti.
Sakadāgāmissa hi pañcindriyāni sakadāgāmibhāvaṃ paṭicca mudūni nāma honti.
